name: Sevelamer
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Sevelamer is a non-absorbed phosphate binder. The US label indication is control of serum phosphorus in chronic kidney disease (CKD) on dialysis; it acts in the gut, so no kidney-function dose adjustment applies.
kidney_function_basis: Not applicable (not absorbed); indication is CKD on dialysis.

bands.recommendation: Not within the US label indication (dialysis only). Specialist input.
Not within the US label indication (dialysis only). Specialist input.
Not within the US label indication (dialysis only). Specialist input.

hd: Not taking a binder: phosphorus >5.5 to <7.5 mg/dL, 0.8 g three times daily with meals; ≥7.5 mg/dL, 1.6 g three times daily. Titrate by 0.8 g per meal every 2 weeks. Average about 7.2 g/day; highest studied 14 g/day (label).
pd: Same dialysis dosing (label indication is CKD on dialysis).
monitoring: Serum phosphorus; GI adverse effects; bicarbonate (label). Follow KDIGO CKD-MBD guidance.

pediatric.approved_ages: CKD on dialysis, 6 years and older; not studied under 6 years (label).
pediatric.usual_dose: By body surface area (BSA): BSA ≥0.75 to <1.2 m2, start 0.8 g per meal/snack, titrate by 0.4 g; BSA ≥1.2 m2, start 1.6 g per meal/snack, titrate by 0.8 g. Titrate every 2 weeks for 6 weeks, then every 4 weeks (label).
pediatric.max_dose: Label gives no pediatric maximum; highest adult dose studied is 14 g/day.

renal.recommendation: Not within the label indication (dialysis only).
Not within the label indication (dialysis only).
Not within the label indication (dialysis only).
Not within the label indication (dialysis only).

pediatric.notes: Less effective in children with low baseline phosphorus (under 13 years and those not on dialysis) (label).
pediatric.egfr_equation: Bedside Schwartz: eGFR (mL/min/1.73 m2) = 0.413 x height (cm) / serum creatinine (mg/dL)

adult: US label is Renvela (sevelamer carbonate, Genzyme, NDA022127). PH also registers sevelamer hydrochloride; dosing equivalence per label switching section.
Non-dialysis CKD use is common in practice (and outside the US label in some countries); bands say 'specialist input'. Decide whether to change.
pediatric: Pediatric dosing is BSA-based, not mg/kg (label).
